display_name.Description: The display name. Must be unique.

kms_key_name.Description: The KMS key used for encryption/decryption in CMEK scenarios. See https://cloud.google.com/security-key-management.

name.Description: The resource name of the processor.

type.Description: The type of processor. For possible types see the [official list](https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations/fetchProcessorTypes#google.cloud.documentai.v1.DocumentProcessorService.FetchProcessorTypes)
